Class OffscreenWindows.Draw

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.script.OffscreenWindows.Draw
Enclosing class:
OffscreenWindows
public static final class OffscreenWindows.Draw extends Object
Transient custom-paint context. Coordinates are absolute scaled GUI units, not native desktop pixels. A retained context rejects use once its callback ends. The native helper restores attributes, matrices and the Minecraft GL cache; custom painting must not change GL contexts or framebuffers.
